$comment: Each check's resident memory at its peak, in GiB, and whether it must run alone; a worker-count check scales its figure per worker. `checks` is keyed by check id or by id family (`typecheck`, `gates`): the most specific entry wins, and an id with no entry fails the run at load. `tiers` gives the time budget of a tier's run in seconds. The runner schedules checks so their memory sums stay inside the run's ceiling, and declines one that cannot fit at all.
